description: Source code implementing time zone formatting and parsing functions, including custom strptime implementation, time formatting with extended specifiers, and parsing logic for date/time strings within the absl::time_internal::cctz namespace.

methods.name: strptime
methods.description: Custom implementation of strptime using C++11's std::get_time() when native strptime is unavailable.

methods.name: ToTM
methods.description: Converts a time_zone::absolute_lookup object to a std::tm structure.

methods.name: ToWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number for a given civil day and week start day.

methods.name: Format64
methods.description: Formats a 64-bit integer into a string with specified width.

methods.name: Format02d
methods.description: Formats an integer as two digits with leading zero if necessary.

methods.name: FormatOffset
methods.description: Formats a UTC offset into a string, e.g., +00:00.

methods.name: FormatTM
methods.description: Formats a std::tm structure into a string using strftime.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a time_point into a string according to a custom format with extended specifiers.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a time_point based on a specified format, handling extended specifiers and time zone adjustments.
